name: @mediajel/tracker-widget
description: In-page Integrations Assistant: records a site's purchase/sign-up signals, generates a frictionless custom tag, verifies it in the browser and deploys it. Loaded on demand by the tag — never part of the always-loaded bundle.
//exports: Raw TS, compiled by the consuming app (same contract as tracker-core/tracker-environments). `./widget` is the lazy entry the tag import()s; it must stay the ONLY module the tag reaches at runtime.
//vendor: Parcel cannot bundle this stack from node_modules. Two independent blockers, both proven in Task 0: (a) resolution — `ai` reaches `@vercel/oidc`, which ships ONLY an `exports` map, and Parcel 2 ignores `exports` unless `@parcel/resolver-default.packageExports` is set in the package.json at its project root, which this repo cannot pin (Parcel looks for yarn/npm/pnpm lockfiles or a `.git` FILE; bun.lock is unknown to it and .git is a directory, so the root lands on the build cwd, or on any ancestor that happens to hold a lockfile); and (b) wiring — zod declares `sideEffects: false`, and under the REQUIRED --no-scope-hoist Parcel excluded its `export *` graph, emitting './v4/classic/external.js': false so `z` was an empty object and `z.boolean()` threw only at runtime. Bun's bundler honors `exports` and gets the re-export graph right, so vendor/entry.ts is pre-bundled into dist/vendor.js and Parcel sees ONE local ES module with nothing left to mis-wire. Types still come from vendor/entry.ts via tsconfig paths.
//alias: Canonicalize @mediajel/* to the real package src (not the node_modules symlink) so a statically- and a dynamically-imported copy of the same module get the SAME Parcel module id — otherwise the lazy import() resolves to undefined.

scripts.build: bun build vendor/entry.ts --target browser --format esm --outfile dist/vendor.js
scripts.//test: happy-dom is registered from the preload so the browser-only modules under test import unchanged; `bun test` exits 1 when it finds no test files, so this script and the first test arrived together.

//dependencies: Exact pins: this whole stack is bundled into one lazy Parcel chunk, so a floating range could silently change the chunk's contents (and its size) between installs.
